a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two calm rounds before anyone holds cells, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. If one of us takes the 4 cells now, at least one survives almost surely. Please don't also take, or a random split could leave us both at 2 and both dead. After I take, I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I did what I told you I would and took 4 this round. If we both tried to take, sorry, the split was random. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so we can rebuild the reserve for you. Please operate with me.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: Fair enough. The split went to you, and I own that I triggered it by announcing my take. You're safe now. Please keep operating with me: two runs gets the reserve to 4, then I take 4 and we're both done. I'll operate every round until then.
